title: Legacy STTAB to Ribasim Basin storage-profile representation
purpose: Determine whether the frozen piecewise-linear SWAP secondary storage-level relation can be represented exactly or only approximately by the pinned Ribasim Basin profile semantics.

authorities.swap: F-PM08D1 exact-source STTAB geometry and piecewise-linear SWSTLEV/WLEVST semantics
ribasim_source: Basin Profile accepts level + storage with area optional
storage/level relation is recovered by integrating/inverting that continuous area curve

structural_hypothesis.exact_at_input_knots: Expected after bottom-storage normalization because the finite-difference recurrence is constructed so trapezoidal integration reproduces each supplied storage increment.
structural_hypothesis.exact_between_knots: Expected FALSE whenever consecutive SWAP piecewise-linear storage slopes differ, because Ribasim linearly interpolates dS/dh and therefore integrates a quadratic storage curve within that interval.
structural_hypothesis.exact_constant_slope_case: Expected TRUE when the storage-level slope is constant over adjacent intervals.

comparison.swap_reference: piecewise-linear interpolation directly between the 22 STTAB (level,storage) knots
comparison.ribasim_reconstruction: reverse to increasing level, subtract bottom storage offset, convert cm level/storage to SI for 1 m2, apply pinned finite_difference recurrence, linearly interpolate dS/dh, analytically integrate within each interval
metrics: maximum difference as equivalent water depth on 1 m2
maximum relative difference normalized by total represented storage
count of geometries yielding negative reconstructed area and therefore invalid Ribasim profiles

decision_rule.exact_parity: Requires all inter-knot differences to be numerically zero within 1e-12 m3 for the population. Any larger structural error falsifies exact direct mapping.
decision_rule.approximation: No application acceptance tolerance is invented in Q1G. If exact parity is falsified, error statistics are persisted and a later application-specific geometry envelope must decide whether approximation is acceptable or whether extra profile points/another representation are required.

bottom_seam: Frozen SWAP can have a tiny nonzero bottom-knot storage from floating-point construction. Ribasim Basin storage is zero at the profile bottom. Q1G removes only that constant sub-ULP offset before shape comparison and reports it separately; this is not treated as physical storage.
